tokenization: lowercase; regex [a-z0-9]+|[U+3400-U+9FFF], same as existing shared runtime
empty_tokens: same as stored runtime:100 when both empty,0 if one empty
FWT: mean pre-task minus base for tasks2..19
BWT: mean final minus just-acquired for tasks1..18
domain_final: original QA-weighted full-test scores within domain; domain-macro separate
selection_reason: User prioritizes output content quality over strict complete-string matching; no metric-shopping based on winning method.
scope_note: Same F1 formula as QA literature; existing multilingual tokenization is explicitly ours, not a claim of byte-identical SQuAD normalization.
